day.title: Day trade
day.long: Top 10% today · volume ≥ 1.5× normal · above VWAP · closing in the top 40% of the day's range · ATR ≥ 2%
day.short: Bottom 10% today · volume ≥ 1.5× · below VWAP · closing in the bottom 40% of the range · ATR ≥ 2%

swing.title: Swing
swing.long: Top 30% on week and month · RS Rating ≥ 60 · close > EMA50 > EMA200 · RSI 50–70 · within 1.5 ATR of the 20-day
swing.short: Bottom 30% on week and month · RS Rating ≤ 40 · close < EMA50 < EMA200 · RSI 30–50 · within 1.5 ATR of the 20-day

hold.title: Hold

hold.short: RS Rating ≤ 15 · bottom half this month · close < EMA50 < EMA200 · 30%+ below the 52-week high
